target: Detected-cell proportions (raw imaging count>0), baseline only, one unexposed male reference donor
anatomy_parameters: Independent fixed-prior hierarchical model for each deposited anatomy and gene; physical sections provide section-heterogeneity groups, not independent animals

fixed_priors.kappa: LogNormal(log(20),1.5); log-scale SD1.5, median20; fixed before fitting
fixed_priors.motivation: Explicit modeling assumptions, not empirically established brain-detection priors; no prior tuning against test data

quadrature.nodes: At q=(i+0.5)/N of each prior; Cartesian product with equal prior-quadrature weights1/(N_mu*N_kappa)
quadrature.weights: Posterior grid weights proportional to product of training-section Beta-Binomial marginal likelihoods; logsumexp normalization
quadrature.approximation: Deterministic finite-grid approximation to continuous prior/posterior; not exact continuous integration or MCMC convergence
quadrature.mu_intervals: Equal-tail2.5/97.5% weighted discrete grid quantiles; finite grid sensitivity quantified, never selected on OOF
quadrature.sensitivity_targets: Full-data mu mean/CI, kappa/rho means and new-section p interval endpoints via numerical Beta-mixture CDF inversion(noMC); held-out96x64 count PI coverage/endpoints and Brier versus prespecified64x48, common-seedMC (count interval differences include MC error)

known_section: Posterior of p_sa is mixture Beta(mu*kappa+y_sa,(1-mu)*kappa+n_sa-y_sa) under full-data hyperposterior; exact mixture mean,8192-seeded-draw interval
anatomy_mu: Mean and95% credible interval for mean propensity across exchangeable physical sections, distinct from pooled cell fraction
new_section_p: Mixture Beta(mu*kappa,(1-mu)*kappa), integrating hyperposterior;95% predictive interval for a new section's latent detection propensity. Full-data intervals/sensitivity numerically invert weighted mixture CDF with scipy betainc/brentq(tolerance1e-12); OOF uses MC draws for joint p/count prediction
new_section_count: New-section propensity drawn from posterior mixture, then Binomial(actual held-out n,p); empirical integer equal-tail95% count predictive interval

MC.quantiles: numpy method=inverted_cdf; empirical count quantiles retain integer support[0,n]
MC.caution: This is MC error of estimated tail probabilities, not an uncertainty bound on probability-quantile locations; no exact continuous posterior claim

cross_validation: Same five contiguous physical-section blocks and neighboring guard labels from prior spatial_bayes section_folds.tsv/fold_audit.json; neither test nor guard data fit posterior or baseline
no_training_anatomy: Use fixed prior-only predictive distribution and flag it; retain OOF scores. No artificial test groups for n=0, no zero-filled missing anatomy
regional_baseline: Same priors/quadrature, collapse anatomy within each TRAINING physical section; posterior mu mean predicts every test anatomy; no test or guard counts

metrics.count_PI_coverage: Fraction observed section×anatomy counts within inclusive95% predictive interval; primary unweighted across nonempty groups
metrics.fraction_MAE: Unweighted mean abs(y/n-E[mu|training]); n-weighted alternative also reported
metrics.Brier: Sum[y*(1-pred)^2+(n-y)*pred^2]/sum(n); cell-weighted predictive loss, not independent-cell inference
metrics.improvement: Regional-baseline Brier minus anatomy-model Brier; positive means lower model loss
metrics.scope: Allgroups plus trained-anatomy-only subset reported; correlated genes/sections, no animal-level CI or superiority test

figure_HY_subset: Twelve largest all-measured-cell-n subregions; independent of gene expression; all49 in full tables and UI
limitations: One unexposed donor; physical sections are not independent animal replication
Section exchangeability is a model assumption; AP-dependent patterns and acquisition effects are not distinguished
Conditional binomial sampling assumes common propensity within each anatomy×section; residual local spatial dependence and celltype composition are not modeled
Detection depends on panel/assay/cell filtering and CCF coverage; no unbiased tissue composition claim
No cellclass-specific effects, expression imputation, RNA magnitude, PM2.5 response, or increased spatial resolution
Intervals are conditional on fixed priors, finite quadrature and observed sampling; calibration may fail and is separately reported
